questions.question: The sitting of the tenth act under (R380)(7), in the light form: the agenda is banked whole (data/b770_sitting_agenda.txt :73), 9 items, one for each FINDINGS heading of b761 to b769 that is no corrigendum. No keystone is written at this sitting. Pass these items whole, or strike items by number (name them in your note).
